heard: The sons of Merari, Mali and Musha stood Founders of the clan, by the Lord understood In the wilderness camp, behind the holy tent The Marlads prepared, where the covenant went Carrying the frames, the posts and the bases too The ropes and the peg, the work assigned to you From 30 to 50, strong for the task Serving the sanctuary, the sacred place The census was taken, every male name Recorded in numbers, history claimed The ledgers are in Kish
